grades.reason: Describes access behavior of vsiselect/vsireg* (illegal vs virtual-instruction exceptions) and register widths. It does not say how one exception is chosen when several apply to the same operation.
Covers how exception entry addresses are calculated (EENTRY, TLBRENTRY, MERRENTRY, ECFG.VS). It says nothing about priority or selection among multiple simultaneous exceptions.
Describes imprecise vector traps and reporting the faulting element in vstart. It does not address selecting among multiple possible exceptions for one operation.
Gives a general overview of application-visible exception types (SYS, BEK, INE, IPE, ADE, FPE). It gives no priority or selection rule for multiple exception conditions.
